publishedDeadlines.label: IPIBS fellowship full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual fellowship consideration date; department accepts applications year-round for starts around August 1.

english.note: Central IELTS minimum has no subscore below 5; PTE Academic 55 with no subscore below 53. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; consult official policy and program-specific requirements.

documents: Statement of experience and professional goals (two to three pages)
requirements.note: Successful applicants normally GPA 3.0 with biology, chemistry and mathematics preparation. Interview in person or Zoom whenever possible. English test exemption for U.S. bachelor's/advanced degree; international credential evaluation required. A non-refundable application fee is required; amount not stated on opened central pages. Limited departmental fee waivers may be available case by case; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

funding.note: Selected IPIBS fellows receive support. Published undated IPIBS stipend $33,000, increasing to $35,000 after candidacy, tuition waiver and health insurance. Fellowship selection and continued support depend on program conditions.
